releaseNote.summary: Instance modifiedAt now moves with every transition (same-state, completion, cancel and fault included) and with each data row an updateData writes; an updateData that changes nothing moves nothing.

migrations.path: Instance metadata.modifiedAt, modifiedAt filter and sort, LastTouchedAt
migrations.title: modifiedAt moves with every transition and every updateData data row
migrations.description: Before: only the set-based status writes (Busy flip and release, un-fault, effective-status projection and its revert, long-poll arm) moved Instances.ModifiedAt, so a completed, cancelled or faulted instance kept a time from before its final transition started, and an updateData did not move it. Now every transition stamps it, a same-state one included (a completion with the same instant as completedAt), and every data row an updateData writes (request body or task output) stamps its enteredAt, as does a stage, tags or key change; an updateData that changes none of these moves nothing. Filters and sorts on modifiedAt, and reports reading it as 'last change', see the new values; rows written before the upgrade keep their old values.
migrations.action: No change is required. Re-check consumers that read modifiedAt as the time of the last status change: it is now the time of the last transition or data change.
